title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In September 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Portland, OR. The crew tore off every layer of old shingles down to the wood deck, laid synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new plastic roof vents, new vent pipe flashings and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roof down to the wood deck
Installed synthetic underlayment, painted drip edge and gable flashing, and self-sealing starter along the eaves
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, capped with standard ridge cap
Put in 24 inch valley metal and new front wall and sidewall flashing
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents and put new double-seal flashings on the vent pipes
body: The old shingles had moss and grit packed into the gaps between tabs, plus one mismatched shingle near the top. The photos below go from the old roof, through the changeover, to the finished shingles.

faqs.question: Did the old roof come off, or did the new shingles go over it?
faqs.answer: It came off. The crew tore off every layer down to the wood deck before the new underlayment and shingles went on.

faqs.question: What shingles went on this Portland roof?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, over synthetic underlayment, finished with standard ridge cap.
